caption: The drawing depicts a single, full-length, off-white gown set against a plain, light beige background. The dress features a fitted bodice with vertical seam lines and a high collar, adorned with horizontal pleating. It has wide, puffed sleeves that are structured in three sections, each gathered tightly at intervals and ending in fitted cuffs. The neckline is adorned with a broad, blue-gray lace or embroidered shawl-like collar that drapes across the shoulders. The skirt is wide and bell-shaped, extending outward and downward, with prominent paneling lines. The hem of the skirt is decorated with a wide band of gathered or pleated ruffle, matching the design of the ruffles on the sleeves. The dress is rendered in soft, muted shades of ivory, cream, and blue-gray, with fine linework and careful shading to emphasize the texture and folds of the fabric. The lower left of the image contains a small, discreet signature reading "Nancy Cram." No other objects are present in the drawing.
title: Wedding Dress
